tagline: A love letter they unlock with a word only they know.
brief: A love-page maker: photos, a song and a letter that only your person can open. The identity should feel warm, sweet and personal, with a small secret in it, and belong to the same family as Lettie the mascot.
criteria: Success: reads as a love letter, ties to Lettie, holds up at 16 px, works in one colour.

concepts.name: Heart Flap
concepts.idea: A heart with a keyhole, tucked into an envelope: a love letter only they can open.
rationale: The gap between heart and pocket is the envelope flap
The keyhole is the secret word
Same envelope and heart as Lettie

next_steps: Switch the site over: icons, header mark, share image
Re-render social profile pictures and covers
